note: Five real failures, each fixed before the slice was called complete.

failures.claim: The first core build stopped on a bool cast to f32.
failures.fix: Cast the flag through u8 in the snapshot writer.

failures.claim: A route-cap test expected a refusal the map never produced.
failures.error: the detour cap must be reachable
failures.fix: Assert the invariant: accepted walls never leave an over-budget route.

failures.claim: The client bridge rejected a Uint8Array as BufferSource.
failures.error: TS2345: Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike> is not assignable to BufferSource
failures.fix: Copy the view into a plain ArrayBuffer before compiling the module.

failures.claim: The enemy pool creator was dropped, so no enemy meshes would draw.
failures.error: TS6133: makeEnemy is declared but its value is never read
failures.fix: Restore the slot creator and call it while growing the pool.

failures.claim: The affordability refresh could re-enable a maxed button.
failures.error: review found maxed upgrades and a full core re-enabled by data-need-brass
failures.fix: Mark maxed buttons with data-maxed and short-circuit the refresh.
